name: habit-tracker
description: Habit Tracker is an interactive habit tracker with daily check-ins, streaks, completion rates and a year heatmap. Your habits stay in your browser.

interface.longDescription: Habit Tracker helps you build routines that stick. Check off today's habits, fill in past days in a week grid, and see current and best streaks, 30-day completion rates and a year heatmap. Supports daily, specific-weekday and times-per-week habits, count habits like 8 glasses of water, and skip days that keep your streak. Undo and redo, JSON and CSV export. The tracker runs entirely in the chat; your habits are never sent to a server.
defaultPrompt: Help me start tracking a daily habit.
Show my habit streaks and progress.
